manifest.$comment: Build-time CodeForge Cloud endpoint manifest. The packaging pipeline rewrites `channel` and fills the matching endpoint for staging/production releases. The renderer never reads this file, and a packaged staging/production build ignores CODEFORGE_CLOUD_URL entirely. Staging/production endpoints are intentionally absent until a real deployment exists: a build for those channels must fail closed rather than fall back to a local address.

terms.note: Anonymous and proxied-client use is documented; profiting from Horde access requires giving back at least as much as taken — CodeForge Free never monetizes this route.

CODEFORGE
Your AI coding agent.

Build, fix, and understand software with an agent that works directly with your project.

CodeForge can explore your codebase, edit files, run commands and tests, and show you exactly what it changed.

Start free with CodeForge-managed AI models. No API key required.

I’m 18 or older and understand that CodeForge can read and modify project files and run commands on this computer according to my approval settings.
Continue with GitHub

GitHub sign-in creates your free CodeForge account. Connect repositories or your own AI providers later if you want — neither is required to start using CodeForge Free.
